analogy.rationale: Steroid drugs act mainly through nuclear receptors such as NR3C1 (glucocorticoid receptor), so other nuclear-receptor ligands should give the most similar transcriptional responses; however, many of these cell lines express low levels of steroid receptors, so the overall response is expected to be weak.
